title: Fix three bugs in a Rust string utilities module
description: Fix bugs in strutil: count_chars returns total length instead of char count, trim_prefix always returns the original string, words splits on comma instead of whitespace.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. count_chars: change to `s.chars().filter(|&ch| ch == c).count()`
2. trim_prefix: change to `if s.starts_with(prefix) { &s[prefix.len()..] } else { s }`
3. words: change `s.split(',')` to `s.split_whitespace()`; note split_whitespace returns iterator not slice — collect to Vec<&str>
All 3 cargo test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
